item.name: KB8 - Compensation also unavailable
item.description: Set PAYMENT_DELAY_MS=15000, recreate order-service, send place order, then stop payment-service and inventory-service after RESERVE_INVENTORY. Restart both before verifying. See scripts/verify_failures.py for deterministic coordination.

exec: pm.test("Wallet snapshot request succeeds", () => { pm.expect(err).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); });
if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.collectionVariables.set("bal_" + w.customerId, w.balance));

const o = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("kb8OrderId", o.id); pm.test("Pending compensation", () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(o.sagaStatus).to.eql("COMPENSATING"); });

if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.test("Balance delta " + w.customerId, () => pm.expect(w.balance).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bal_" + w.customerId)) + (balanceDelta[w.customerId] || 0))));

const logs = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Exactly three compensation failures", () => pm.expect(logs.filter(l => l.step === "COMPENSATION" && l.result === "FAILED")).to.have.length(3)); pm.test("No false cancellation", () => pm.expect(logs.some(l => l.step === "CANCEL_ORDER")).to.be.false);
